known_facts_book1: Lives on Uncle Henry and Aunt Em's farm in Kansas; the story opens near her farm-house.
Meets the shaggy man when he asks her the road to Butterfield, and while showing him the way the roads mysteriously multiply and the two become lost.
Her little dog Toto has been hidden in the shaggy man's coat pocket along with his stolen apples.
Gets lost 'in fifteen minutes, so near to her home and in the unromantic State of Kansas.'
Takes the seventh road at the shaggy man's suggestion and so begins the journey toward Oz.
Finds Button-Bright digging a hole in the road, and later meets Polychrome dancing in the road.
Is already a Princess of Oz and a friend of Ozma; kings and beasts recognize her by name.
Rides across the Deadly Desert in Johnny Dooit's sand-boat with her companions.
Is reunited in the Winkie country with Tik-tok and Billina, whom Ozma sent to welcome her.
Rides into the Emerald City in Ozma's golden chariot drawn by the Cowardly Lion and Hungry Tiger.
Sits in Ozma's throne and receives the birthday guests in the Throne-Room as the only other Princess in the city.
Learns from Ozma that it was Ozma who mixed up the roads to start her wandering toward Oz.
At the end is transported home to her Kansas bed by Ozma's Magic Belt while she sleeps, rather than riding a bubble.

known_relations_book1.Shaggy Man: Her fellow traveler from the first page; she shows him the road, is lost with him, and brings him to Oz as her friend.
known_relations_book1.Toto: Her own dog, who travels the whole road with her.
known_relations_book1.Button-Bright: A lost little boy she adopts into the party and mothers along the road.
known_relations_book1.Polychrome: The Rainbow's Daughter she befriends on the road and calls 'Polly'.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: Her dear friend and the Ruler of Oz, who made her a Princess and watches her journey in the Magic Picture.
known_relations_book1.Billina: An old friend, the Yellow Hen, who names all ten of her new chicks Dorothy.
known_relations_book1.Tik-tok: An old friend, the copper clockwork man, sent by Ozma to welcome her.
known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: An old friend; she walks arm in arm with him in the birthday procession.
known_relations_book1.Tin Woodman: An old friend, Nick Chopper, who welcomes her to his tin castle.

known_facts_book1: Makes his very first appearance in the series here, opening the book by asking Dorothy the road to Butterfield.
Owns the Love Magnet, a dull brown horseshoe-shaped bit of metal that makes every living thing he meets love him.
Confesses at the end that he stole the Love Magnet from a girl in Butterfield who was loved too much, though he had first told Dorothy an Eskimo gave it to him.
Everything about him is shaggy: his clothes, boots, hair, and whiskers.
Puts Toto and stolen apples in his big coat pocket at the start.
Avoids Butterfield because a man there owes him fifteen cents and he does not want the money.
Is given a donkey head by King Kik-a-bray of Dunkiton, which he later washes off in the Truth Pond.
Summons his friend Johnny Dooit by means of the Love Magnet to build a sand-boat across the Deadly Desert.
Defeats the Scoodlers by catching their thrown heads and hurling them into the black gulf.
Is given fine new clothes at Ozma's palace that are still shaggy, so he remains the Shaggy Man.
Gives up the Love Magnet to be hung over the gates of the Emerald City so all who pass may love and be loved.
Is allowed by Ozma to remain and live in Oz if he proves honest and true.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: The little girl he asks for directions and then travels the whole road to Oz beside.
known_relations_book1.Love Magnet: The charm he owns and carries, which makes everyone love him.
known_relations_book1.Johnny Dooit: His powerful friend, summoned by the Love Magnet, who builds the sand-boat.
known_relations_book1.Button-Bright: The lost boy he takes charge of and carries when danger comes.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler who grants him leave to live in Oz on probation.

known_facts_book1: Makes his very first appearance in the series here, found digging a hole in the road in sailor clothes.
Answers almost every question with 'Don't know.'
Is called Button-Bright because his papa said he was 'bright as a button'; his real name and home are unknown.
Seems two or three years younger than Dorothy and does not know where he came from.
Loves the shaggy man at once because of the Love Magnet.
Is given a fox head by King Dox of Foxville, who thinks it makes him look clever.
Has his own head restored by falling into the Truth Pond in the Winkie country.
Weeps and protests 'Don't want to be soup!' when the Scoodlers capture the party.
Santa Claus knows him and has visited his home several Christmas Eves.
Is sent home to his father and mother at the end inside one of the Wizard's soap-bubbles.

known_relations_book1.King Dox: The Fox-King who gives him a fox head.

known_facts_book1: Makes her very first appearance in the series here, found dancing and weeping in the lonely road.
Is the Daughter of the Rainbow, clad in flowing gauzy robes of soft rainbow tints, with hair like spun gold.
Slid off the end of her father's rainbow when it touched the road and was left behind when he lifted it again.
Dances to keep warm because she is used to living nearer the sun and finds the earth cold.
Eats almost nothing, preferring dewdrops and mist-cakes to solid food, and lets Dorothy call her 'Polly'.
Slaps the Scoodler guard's face as part of the shaggy man's escape plan.
Performs her Rainbow Dance at Ozma's banquet.
Goes home at the end by dancing up the curve of a rainbow that settles onto the platform, after Santa Claus promises to tell her father where she is.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: Her first earthly friend, who names her 'Polly' and invites her to travel to Oz.
known_relations_book1.the Rainbow: Her father, from whose bow she fell and to whom she finally returns.
known_relations_book1.Shaggy Man: A travelling companion she scolds for braying 'hee-haw' with his donkey head.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler who welcomes her warmly and whose beauty she admits surpasses her own.

known_facts_book1: Dorothy's little black dog with bright brown eyes, who begins the book stuffed into the shaggy man's pocket with the apples.
Barks at and tries to bite the fox-soldiers, the Musicker, and Billina, and is repeatedly quieted by Dorothy.
Grabs a Scoodler's thrown head by the ear and runs off with it during the fight.
Turns 'invisible' among the grey rocks near the Scoodler country only because he cannot be seen, and is found by his barking.
Sits at the animals' table at the banquet with a bib and a silver platter.
Is carried home to Kansas with Dorothy by the Magic Belt, having declined to ride in a bubble.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: His mistress, whom he follows everywhere 'like Mary's little lamb'.
known_relations_book1.Shaggy Man: Carries Toto in his pocket at the start and is bitten by the dog for it.
known_relations_book1.Billina: The Yellow Hen he tries to attack until Dorothy commands him to treat her as a friend.
